source.title: A Nonstabilizerness Resource Law for Universal Quantum State Purification
source.authors: Keming He, Enji Xiong and Xin Wang

related_peer_reviewed_source.title: No-Go Theorems for Universal Quantum State Purification via Classically Simulable Operations

novelty.summary: The preprint reports an exact linear mana law for universal two-copy purification in odd dimensions, a two-sided linear robustness law for multi-qubit systems (exact for one qubit), and an explicit successful purification map. The related peer-reviewed result supplies a scoped two-copy no-go boundary for classically simulable operations.
limitations: Preprint not independently reproduced by UQPU.
Exact assumptions, definitions, quantifiers and proof dependencies must be transcribed from the full source.
Three/four-copy extensions in the related work are SDP/numerical evidence and must not be labeled as the same proof-level theorem.
Mana and robustness are not directly hardware gates, shots, joules, dollars or accepted useful outputs.
